mission_statement: Our lab's mission is to understand how T cells recognize disease and to harness that knowledge to build more precise therapies. Through immune-specificity mapping in human patient samples, combined with high-throughput genetic screens, single-cell profiling, and synthetic biology, we define the antigen-specific basis of autoimmunity, cancer, and infectious disease to enable next-generation treatments that target immune specificities with the goal of curing or preventing disease.
